description: This file contains a simple implementation of a FastCGI server used for unit testing. It processes a single FastCGI request at a time, listening on a socket, and responds with hard-coded results based on the request parameters. The code includes platform-specific socket handling for Windows and Unix-like systems, and defines various functions for handling FastCGI protocol details such as headers, environment variables, and request processing.

methods.name: void fcgi_header(FCGI_Header * const header,const unsigned char type,const int request_id,const int contentLength,const unsigned char paddingLength)
methods.description: Constructs a FastCGI header with specified type, request id, content length, and padding.

methods.name: void fcgi_unknown_type_rec(FCGI_UnknownTypeRecord * const rec,const int req_id,const unsigned char type)
methods.description: Creates a record for an unknown FastCGI record type.

methods.name: void fcgi_end_request_rec(FCGI_EndRequestRecord * const rec,const int req_id,const uint32_t appStatus,const unsigned char protocolStatus)
methods.description: Creates an End Request record with application status and protocol status.

methods.name: int fcgi_puts(const int req_id,const char * const str,size_t len,FILE * const stream)
methods.description: Sends data with FastCGI stdout records in chunks, streaming the provided string to the client.

methods.name: const char * fcgi_getenv(const unsigned char * const r,const uint32_t rlen,const char * const name,int nlen,int * len)
methods.description: Retrieves environment variables from the FastCGI request, searching in the request record or falling back to getenv.

methods.name: int fcgi_process_params(FILE * const stream,int req_id,int role,unsigned char * const r,uint32_t rlen)
methods.description: Processes the FastCGI request parameters to generate appropriate responses based on query string values.

methods.name: int fcgi_dispatch_packet(FILE * stream,ssize_t offset,uint32_t len)
methods.description: Dispatches incoming FastCGI packets based on their type and handles each accordingly.

methods.name: ssize_t fcgi_recv_packet(FILE * const stream,ssize_t sz)
methods.description: Receives and processes FastCGI packets from the socket stream.

methods.name: int fcgi_recv(const SOCKET fd,FILE * const stream)
methods.description: Main loop for receiving FastCGI data from the socket, processing packets, and handling connection lifecycle.

methods.name: int main(void)
methods.description: Entry point for the FastCGI server; initializes platform-specific socket handling and accepts connections, passing them to the request processor.
